entries.title: Definition of Rape
entries.content: Any person who has unlawful carnal knowledge of a woman or girl, without her consent, or with her consent if the consent is obtained by force or by means of threats or intimidation of any kind, or by fear of bodily harm, is guilty of the felony termed rape.
entries.source: Penal Code Cap 7:01, Laws of Malawi

entries.title: Defilement of Girls under 16
entries.content: Any person who unlawfully and carnally knows any girl under the age of sixteen years is guilty of a felony and is liable to imprisonment for life.
entries.source: Penal Code Cap 7:01, Laws of Malawi

entries.title: Assault Causing Actual Bodily Harm
entries.content: Any person who commits an assault occasioning actual bodily harm is guilty of a misdemeanor and is liable to imprisonment for five years.
entries.source: Penal Code Cap 7:01, Laws of Malawi
